intro: Built for modern living, our Axl wardrobe offers durable steel strength, smart storage, and sleek style—designed to fit your space and simplify your day.

features.title: Built to last a lifetime
features.text: Made with premium CRCA steel and advanced powder coating, the wardrobe is rust-resistant, termite-proof, and ready to stand the test of time.

features.title: Spacious, versatile storage
features.text: Includes full-length hanging space, adjustable shelves, and drawers—everything you need to store clothes, accessories, or documents with ease.

features.title: Safe and secure locker
features.text: An integrated locker gives you a private space to store valuables, ensuring safety and peace of mind right inside your wardrobe.

features.title: Privacy redefined
features.text: Dual locks offer individual door security, letting you safeguard essentials on either side—perfect for shared spaces or personal privacy.
